## Ses vi til Digital Tech Summit? 🤗 Forskere fra ITU står klar til at belyse nogle af de…

*October 27, 2026*

Ses vi til [Digital Tech Summit](https://dk.linkedin.com/company/digital-tech-summit)? 🤗 Forskere fra ITU står klar til at belyse nogle af de vigtigste teknologiske spørgsmål i vores tid ✨

Det sker til årets største tech-event, som finder sted i næste uge.

Her samles forskere, virksomheder, beslutningstagere, startups og offentlige aktører omkring de nyeste tendenser inden for AI, data, cybersikkerhed, kvanteteknologi og digital innovation.

(Pssst! Det er helt gratis at deltage...)

Vanen tro deltager ITU med et hav af spændende indlæg og debatter 👏

Du kan bl.a. møde:

🧑💻 [Oliver Krancher](https://dk.linkedin.com/in/oliver-krancher-04736234) til en talk om GenAI i softwareudvikling. Har vi at gøre med et produktivitetsboost, eller er der også en risiko for tab af mening?

📈 [Zoi Kaoudi](https://dk.linkedin.com/in/zoi-kaoudi-96a4749) og Martin Hentschel med ny viden om, hvordan data- og AI-systemer kan lære at optimere sig selv automatisk for at blive mere effektive og energibesparende.

🚴 [Michael Szell](https://dk.linkedin.com/in/michael-szell), der vil fortælle om BikeNetKit: et open source-værktøj, der bruger algoritmer til at analysere og planlægge cykelnetværk i byer. Formålet er at gøre beslutninger om cykelinfrastruktur mere databaserede og tilgængelige, så byer lettere kan fremme bæredygtig transport.

🧠 [Paolo Burelli](https://dk.linkedin.com/in/burelli) vil give et fascinerende indblik i [ITU brAIn lab](https://dk.linkedin.com/company/itu-brain-lab), hvor forskere undersøger grænsefladen mellem hjerner, teknologi og bevidsthed. Måske kan vi i fremtiden styre teknologi med vores tanker frem for tastatur og mus?

💥 [Miguel Sicart](https://dk.linkedin.com/in/miguelsicart) med et kritisk oplæg om AI-agenter med den fabelagtige titel "How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Agentic AI".

💁 Derudover kan du dagene igennem møde os i 𝗜𝗧𝗨-𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗻, hvor forskere og repræsentanter fra ITU's centre, labs, innovationshub og efteruddannelsesteam står klar til at fortælle om de mange muligheder for samarbejde.

Få overblik over ITU's deltagelse her: [itu.dk/Om-ITU/Presse/Nyheder/2026/ITU-paa-DTS-2026](https://itu.dk/Om-ITU/Presse/Nyheder/2026/ITU-paa-DTS-2026)

Vi glæder os! Kom endelig og hils på! 👋

## A great week at ACM ICMI 2026 in beautiful Naples!

*October 12, 2026*

On Friday, I presented our paper, Pseudo-Label Augmentation for Affect Sensing in Small Collaborative Groups, at the Collective States workshop. Building on GroupAffect-4, we explore how to learn from sparse self-reported affect labels without repeatedly interrupting the conversation to ask participants how they feel.

It was also great to spend time with [Paolo Burelli](https://dk.linkedin.com/in/burelli) and [Shan Ahmed Shaffi](https://dk.linkedin.com/in/shanahmedshaffi), who presented our other paper, Backchannel-Aware Transcription for Multiparty Conversation: ASR Omissions, Acoustic Recovery, and Cross-Corpus Transfer. This work looks at the small listener responses, such as “mm-hmm” and “yeah”, that automatic transcription can miss.

The conference was a great opportunity to connect with the community, discuss ideas and get fresh inspiration for our upcoming Mega Capture of multiparty conversations at the CogniSense Lab at GN Hearing.

Many thanks to all my co-authors across these two papers: [Paolo Burelli](https://dk.linkedin.com/in/burelli), [Shan Ahmed Shaffi](https://dk.linkedin.com/in/shanahmedshaffi), [Tanya Ignatenko](https://nl.linkedin.com/in/tanya-ignatenko-373bb82), [Fabricio Batista Narcizo](https://dk.linkedin.com/in/fabricionarcizo), Anna Obara, [Alice Modica](https://dk.linkedin.com/in/alice-modica-a18589302), [Jesper Bünsow Boldt](https://dk.linkedin.com/in/jbboldt) and [Andrew Dittberner](https://www.linkedin.com/in/andrew-dittberner-5233783).And thank you to [ITU brAIn lab](https://dk.linkedin.com/company/itu-brain-lab), [GN Advanced Science](https://dk.linkedin.com/showcase/gn-advanced-science/) and [Innovation Fund Denmark](https://dk.linkedin.com/company/danmarksinnovationsfond) for supporting this work.

## Had a great week at the 28th ACM International Conference on Multimodal Interaction…

*October 8, 2026*

Had a great week at the 28th ACM International Conference on Multimodal Interaction, ICMI 2026 in Naples. Great location, amazing research and amazing food for my first ICMI experience :)

## The poster is ready for ECCV 2026! 🎉

*September 7, 2026*

This Wednesday afternoon, I’ll present our paper, “From Windows to Sequences: Modality-Aware Temporal Learning for Wearable Affect Sensing,” at the WearableAI workshop.  
I’ll be sharing GroupAffect-4, our multimodal dataset of four-person conversations, and what we learned about modelling wearable signals across different timescales.  
If you’re in Malmö and interested in wearable AI, multimodal sensing or understanding listeners in real conversations, come by and say hello—I’d love to chat!

## The ITU brAIn lab team is in Madrid for the IEEE Conference on Games.

*September 2, 2026*

The [ITU brAIn lab](https://dk.linkedin.com/company/itu-brain-lab)  team is in Madrid for the [IEEE Conference on Games](https://pt.linkedin.com/company/ieee-conference-on-games). Among many awesome presentations on game AI, PCG and player experience, [Oleg J.](https://dk.linkedin.com/in/ojarmam)  presented our pilot study on player experience and psychophysiology "Atari Games Challenge: A Pilot Study on Multimodal Player Experience Assessment ([arxiv.org/abs/2605.27261](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27261)).  
He discussed the nature of the dataset ([zenodo.org/records/17699260](https://zenodo.org/records/17699260)), some early results of the study and his analysis on the nature and characteristics of immersion, mastery and challenge in games.
